channel.title: Uganda - The African Street Journal
channel.description: Daily news from Uganda, every source cited.

item.title: C-Care and DFCU Bank expand health insurance
item.description: The partnership aims to make comprehensive medical cover more accessible to individuals and families across Uganda.

item.title: Museveni warns MPs on digital number plate report accuracy
item.description: President cautions legislators against inaccurate findings in the controversial digital number plates project.

item.title: EACOP opens latrine and gives sports gear to Kabonera
item.description: The pipeline company also donated footballs, jerseys, and netball posts to the community.

item.title: Ugandan comedian Kapere dies in Buddo
item.description: Popular comedian Yokana Mbuuse, known as Kapere Lufotose, died on Saturday, November 1, 2026, at a medical facility in Buddo.

item.title: Uganda launches e-waste collection drive
item.description: Health Minister Chris Baryomunsi announced plans for city cleanliness competitions and waste-to-value initiatives.
